initial:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: two complete, coherent pixel-art map animation poses for Hunapu, Dawn Warrior, a young male blue-haired hero.
Input image 1 is the PRIMARY POSE reference: the original very small three-color tactical sprites, four horizontal slots labelled 2,3,6,7. Reproduce ONLY the FIRST TWO poses (slots 2 and 3, moving to screen-right). Their slightly twisted body posture and oblique cross-body sword/low shield arrangement are authoritative.
Input image 2 is APPEARANCE reference only: preserve this young man's solid short blue hair, tan face, pale-blue segmented armor, navy clothing and boots, short split coat/mantle, small blue shield. Do NOT copy its incorrect lower-row upper-body poses.
Input image 3 is the sword DESIGN reference: angular silver blade with blue central spine/open slot, round blue gem at guard, dark grip/pommel and short blue ribbon.

Deliver one transparent image with TWO FULL BODY sprites arranged in a single horizontal row, generous separate margins, no labels, no background, no ground shadows, no extra poses. Same character scale and same head, shoulder, waist and ground heights in both.

USER-CONFIRMED ANATOMY and COMPOSITION, essential:
The face remains visible toward the viewer, with a subtle turn toward screen-right. Both eyes are visible; this is a battle-ready lateral walk. Chest remains visible but shoulders/hips are slightly staggered and twisted toward screen-right; head is slightly to screen-right of the hips. The stance has a small forward/side lean, rather than a square upright symmetrical front portrait.
The sword hand is ON THE SCREEN-RIGHT side, with the hand at lower chest/upper abdomen, elbow slightly outside the right silhouette and forearm angling across the front. The sword is firmly gripped by its DARK HANDLE below the blue circular guard. From this lower central/right hilt the LONG blade passes diagonally ACROSS THE CHEST up toward the upper SCREEN-LEFT. It is an actual cross-body guard, not a blade propped beside the left shoulder. Make the right-side forearm, fist, handle and guard readable.
The OTHER arm holds a SMALL shield low at SCREEN-LEFT of the abdomen/hip, in FRONT of the body, close to the body, just below ribs. The shield face partly overlaps the low forearm; pale-blue rim and dark-blue face. Shield is NOT on the right chest, not a backpack, not centered high on the chest. Only one shield and one sword in each pose.
Left sprite: original slot 2's narrow/pass stance, knees softly flexed, feet drawn close and one lower leg slightly overlapping the other.
Right sprite: original slot 3's wider lateral stride toward screen-right, bent legs spread left/right; keep the SAME upper-body cross-body guard and subtle lean. Natural small changes in elbow/forearm/coat folds with the step, no disconnected legs pasted underneath. Stable head and torso center, no whole body bob. Full figures must be authored together.

Style: crisp polished pixel art with dark navy outlines, readable compact anatomy, limited palette (navy outlines, deep blue, soft medium blue, pale icy blue, muted tan skin, near-white silver). Same restrained saturation and brightness as the appearance reference. FLAT SOLID blue hair, matte cloth, no hair highlight streaks, no glossy armor sparkle, no gradients, no glow, no effects. Keep the eyes and face small and mature as reference, not oversized cute eyes. Preserve clear silhouette and the sword's full tip. Do not crop. Transparent background.
correction:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct ONLY the weapon-hand anatomy of BOTH full-body sprites on this transparent sheet. Keep their appearance, clothes, leg positions, full-body size, layout, and transparent background.

CRITICAL CORRECTION: The reference sheet has the sword fist on SCREEN-LEFT and shield on SCREEN-RIGHT, which is WRONG. REVERSE THESE ARM ROLES in both sprites, while retaining the sword blade's tip at upper SCREEN-LEFT.

Put the small blue shield on SCREEN-LEFT, LOW beside the left abdomen and hip. Shield top at lower ribs, shield bottom at hip/upper thigh, not on the shoulder. The shield is held close in front by the bent left-of-image forearm. Completely remove the shield on screen-right.

Put the SWORD FIST ON SCREEN-RIGHT at waist/upper abdomen, just to the right of the body's centerline. The screen-right elbow bends outward, forearm points inward across the front, hand grips the black HANDLE; round blue circular guard directly above that fist. From this LOWER SCREEN-RIGHT guard a LONG silver/blue blade angles diagonally across the entire CHEST toward UPPER SCREEN-LEFT. Sword must visibly CROSS THE FRONT OF THE CHEST from right-low to left-high; the sword guard must not be next to the left shoulder. Left-to-right horizontal order at waist: small shield, torso, sword fist. One sword and one shield per sprite.

Retain visible front face with subtle rightward turn, chest slightly twisted, hips slightly left of the head. Same stable head and waist centers across narrow-stance and wide-stride poses. Solid uniform blue hair with dark outline, NO blue hair shine/streaks; matte armor and cloth; crisp limited-palette pixel art. No text, no scene, no shadow, no effects. Full complete figures without cropping.
user_confirmed: Face forward with slight directional torso twist; cross-body sword guard, low shield in front; narrow/overlap and wide stride phases; opposite direction follows native mirror.
